drive_speed_limit_motor_rpm_source: Owner decision 2026-09-15: A6M rated speed 3000 rpm, spec sheet and A6M60-400H2B1-M17 / A6M80-1000H2B1-M17 part numbers. One motor revolution is 131072 counts in the drive frame regardless of the electronic gear ratio, so a motor speed cap does not scale with the gear: 0x607F counts/s = drive_speed_limit_motor_rpm / 60 * motor_encoder_counts_per_rev. Independent of the inhibited start-up verification speed bound and software limits.max_velocity. Raising the drive cap exposes axis 0's existing software limit: compiled effective_max_velocity increases from 0.0016666412353515624 to 0.005 m/s; the configured limits.max_velocity remains 0.005 m/s.
